title: Pilot CI pipeline
content:
Background

Based on Planners, Current DevOps Status and preferred tools from enterprise architecture.

  • A core pilot tool chain for CI & CD has been defined

  • DEXF has been chosen as pliot project

High level requirements

  • Align with enterprise architecture landscape

  • Remove locally bought tools. Bitbucket is used as repository today and is paid by credit card.

  • Use a more stable software development platform. Requests from projects to move to GitHub due to better stability and usability in handling of pull requests.

Currently as an organizational member I can invite external users as collaborators to a specific repository but this does not scale. A solution would involve usage of GtiHub Teams function.

Alt 1:

Set up Azure AD integration which implies connect Ad group to a GitHub Team. Admin of AD group handle users.

GitHub user management via Azure AD
